facts.fact: Four 在 Rookery 的亮光下显得气势逼人，与火车夜色里判若两人；Jove 举枪顶他头时他眼睛都没眨。
facts.anchor: Four was striking on the train, in the dark, by the light of the moon.

facts.fact: Four 带来一个头缠绷带的 Dauntless 女孩 Christina，介绍给 Evelyn，并提她曾说过这里是安全庇护所。
facts.anchor: “This is Christina.” He nods to the girl next to him.

facts.fact: Evelyn 当面要 Tris 把三条规矩讲给 Christina 听，Tris 不愿像训练过的鸟一样背，但为了表忠心照做了。
Four 拒绝由 Tris 送他出去，说她本身就是 Evelyn 用来操纵他的手段。
facts.anchor: “I don’t need a babysitter,” he says. “Least of all one who’s an obvious attempt to manipulate me.”

facts.fact: 隧道里 Four 自报身份是新兵教官兼模拟技术员，负责给 Dauntless 成员做恐惧模拟。
facts.anchor: “I’m an initiation instructor,” he says, “and a simulation technician.”

facts.fact: Tris 从两人并肩时同样的下颌与皱眉认出 Four 就是 Tobias Eaton，即 Evelyn 的儿子。
Tris 回敬自己的姓是 Prior，让他想起她就是当年在他母亲葬礼上登门送花的那家人。
facts.anchor: “My last name is Prior,” I say.

facts.fact: 巷口传来 Dauntless 巡逻队的说话声，她本能抬手把 Tobias 按回墙上，两人贴着墙等脚步声远去。
facts.anchor: I move on instinct, bringing a hand up to his chest and pushing him back against the building.
